body.descriptionPlain:
Blueland is reimagining everyday cleaning essentials with safe, products that are free from single-use plastic and eliminate the need to choose between what’s safe for your family, good for the planet, and proven to work. With 45 patents granted & 39 patents pending worldwide, Blueland’s innovative products have diverted over 1 billion single-use plastic bottles from landfills and oceans and 7.5 million pounds of CO2 from the atmosphere since 2019. While traditional cleaners are packaged in plastic and may contain up to 95% water, all Blueland products utilize tablet or powder formats, designed to be used directly or mixed with household tap water, and come in compostable or recyclable packaging. From the kitchen sink to the laundry room, we create products families can trust and afford to use over and over (and over) again. Available on Blueland.com and nationwide at Target, Costco, Whole Foods and select local retailers.
 
In a world where half of the planet’s carbon emissions come from just 36 companies, we believe that business should be a force for good and that mission and profit are not mutually exclusive—in fact, we’re proof of it. We’re committed to holding ourselves to the highest parental and environmental standards—which includes ongoing and unbiased certifications from trusted third-party organizations like Cradle to Cradle, EPA Safer Choice, USDA BioPreferred, Leaping Bunny, and EWG Verified. We’re also a Certified Climate Neutral business and certified B Corp “Best for the World.”
 
Blueland was featured on the Season 11 premiere of Shark Tank and successfully secured an investment. We’re also well-funded by top tier venture capital firms as well as notable investors including Gwyneth Paltrow, Justin Timberlake and founders of Sweetgreen, Thrive Market, Honest Company, Rent the Runway, and Bonobos. Our products have been featured across top tier outlets including the New York Times, Fast Company, TechCrunch, VOGUE, Wall Street Journal, Inc., and more.

lists.content: Blueland is looking for a highly analytical and collaborative Demand Planner to own demand planning across our omnichannel business. In this role, you will partner closely with channel and cross-functional leaders to develop accurate, actionable demand forecasts that translate commercial plans into a clear view of future demand. You will lead the demand consensus process, bringing together historical performance, channel plans, promotions, launches, and business insights to establish a single aligned demand plan. This role reports to the Director of Supply Chain and sits at the intersection of Sales, Growth, Finance, Operations, playing an important role in helping Blueland balance product availability, inventory efficiency, and growth.

Omnichannel Demand Forecasting
  • Develop and maintain SKU-level demand forecasts across DTC, retail, and marketplace channels, across appropriate weekly and monthly planning horizons.
  • Build forecasts using historical demand, trends, seasonality, promotions, customer and retailer plans, marketing activity, new product launches, and other relevant demand drivers.
  • Develop forecasts for new products and channels where historical demand may be limited, establishing assumptions and analogs and refining forecasts as actual performance develops.
  • Identify changes in demand patterns and proactively adjust forecasts as new information becomes available.
  • Maintain an appropriate view of baseline demand versus incremental demand from promotions, launches, distribution gains, marketing events, and other commercial activity.
    • Demand Consensus
  • Support Blueland’s recurring demand consensus process, bringing together channel leaders and cross-functional partners around a single aligned demand forecast. 
  • Prepare materials and insights that highlight forecast changes, key assumptions, risks, opportunities, and areas requiring business decisions.
  • Challenge assumptions constructively and use data to reconcile differences between statistical forecasts, channel expectations, and business targets.
  • Document forecast assumptions and decisions to create transparency and accountability across teams.
  • Translate the agreed demand plan into clear inputs for supply, inventory, and financial planning.
    • Forecast Accuracy & Insights
  • Establish and monitor demand planning KPIs, including forecast accuracy and forecast bias at the appropriate SKU, channel, and category levels.
  • Conduct regular forecast-versus-actual analysis to understand drivers of variance and continuously improve forecast quality. 
  • Identify systematic forecast bias and recommend changes to assumptions, processes, or forecasting methodologies. 
  • Distinguish true consumer demand from inventory constraints, out-of-stocks, retailer ordering patterns, and other factors that may distort historical sales. 
  • Develop reporting that gives stakeholders visibility into demand trends, forecast changes, and key risks and opportunities.
    • Demand Planning Data & Systems 
  • Maintain demand forecasts and associated SKU and channel data within Blueland’s planning systems.
  • Ensure SKU attributes, product hierarchies, channel mappings, lifecycle statuses, launch dates, and other planning inputs remain accurate and up to date.
  • Support new SKU, customer, and channel setup within planning systems.
  • Maintain forecast versions and planning assumptions to ensure a clear and reliable source of truth.
  • Identify opportunities to improve planning tools, reporting, automation, and data quality.
    • Cross-Functional Partnership
  • Work closely with Supply Planning and Operations to translate demand forecasts into inventory and supply requirements and surface potential availability risks. 
  • Partner with DTC and Growth/Marketing teams to incorporate acquisition plans, promotional calendars, subscriptions, campaigns, and other demand-driving activity. 
  • Partner closely with Finance on the annual budgeting and planning process, translating channel and SKU-level demand assumptions into inputs that support revenue and unit targets. 
  • Reconcile the operational demand plan against financial targets and clearly identify and communicate gaps, risks, and opportunities. 
  • Provide demand forecasts, assumptions, variance analysis, risks, and opportunities as key inputs into monthly consensus and Stage Gate meetings, ensuring leadership and cross-functional teams have a clear and current view of expected demand and the drivers behind changes to the plan. 
  • Support scenario planning and sensitivity analysis to help the business understand the inventory and supply implications of changes in demand.

• 7+ years of experience in demand planning, forecasting, supply chain planning, inventory planning, or a related analytical role, ideally within a consumer products or omnichannel environment.
  • Experience forecasting across multiple channels such as DTC/E-commerce, Amazon or other marketplaces, and wholesale/retail.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to turn complex data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Strong understanding of demand planning fundamentals, including forecasting methods, seasonality, promotional impacts, new product forecasting, forecast accuracy, and bias.
  • Experience working with large SKU-level datasets and maintaining strong data accuracy and discipline.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to facilitate consensus among teams with different perspectives and objectives.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where priorities, channels, and demand signals can change quickly.
  • A proactive problem solver who identifies risks and opportunities rather than simply reporting them.

• Experience in CPG, beauty, personal care, household products, or another high-growth consumer brand.
  • Experience with an integrated business planning or S&OP process.
  • Experience forecasting for retail customers and working with retailer forecasts, POS data, and purchase orders.
  • Experience with subscription or replenishment-based DTC businesses.
  • Experience with Amazon or other marketplace forecasting and inventory dynamics.
The salary range for this position is $120,000-140,000 per year.

lists.content:
Blueland is seeking a Senior Manager, Packaging Engineering and Procurement to lead both the technical development of our packaging and the strategic management of our packaging supply base. 

This role will own packaging from technical concept through commercialization and ongoing procurement, ensuring Blueland’s primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging delivers against our standards for sustainability, product protection, consumer experience, manufacturability, quality, cost, and supply continuity. 

The ideal candidate combines strong packaging engineering expertise with commercial and sourcing capabilities. This role reports to the Director of Procurement & Technical Services and will serve as Blueland’s packaging technical expert, while owning supplier strategy, sourcing initiatives, cost optimization, and supplier performance across the packaging category.

• Own packaging development from concept through commercialization for new product launches, line extensions, and renovations, including material selection, prototyping, specifications, testing, qualification, and production scale-up. 
  • Lead packaging trials, line validations, and performance testing to ensure primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging meets all requirements. 
  • Partner with R&D, Operations, Quality, Marketing, Creative, and external manufacturing partners to translate product and business requirements into technically robust, scalable packaging solutions. 
  • Influence cross-functional decision-making by clearly communicating technical and commercial tradeoffs and balancing sustainability, cost, quality, speed, aesthetics, consumer experience, manufacturability, and supply continuity. 
  • Develop and maintain Blueland’s packaging technical standards and specifications, including component specifications, drawings, BOM requirements, test protocols, qualification reports, pallet configurations, and packaging acceptance criteria. 
  • Own the strategic sourcing and procurement strategy for Blueland’s packaging portfolio, including supplier identification, competitive sourcing, negotiations, supplier selection, contracting, and ongoing commercial management. 
  • Develop and manage the packaging supplier network to ensure competitive cost, technical capability, capacity, quality, sustainability, service, and supply continuity as Blueland grows. 
  • Lead packaging RFPs and commercial negotiations to deliver measurable cost savings and improved commercial terms. 
  • Build a multi-year pipeline of cost savings and value-engineering initiatives across materials, component designs, specifications, suppliers, case packs, pallet configurations, and distribution systems. 
  • Build relationships with innovative packaging suppliers and maintain expertise on emerging materials, manufacturing technologies, sustainability standards, and packaging regulations.

• Bachelor’s degree in Packaging Science, Packaging Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Materials Science, or a related technical discipline, with 7+ years of relevant experience in packaging engineering, packaging development, strategic sourcing, or related CPG functions. 
  • Demonstrated technical expertise developing and commercializing primary, secondary, and tertiary packaging, combined with experience working directly with packaging suppliers, contract manufacturers, and 3PLs. 
  • Strong commercial and analytical capabilities, with demonstrated experience in supplier negotiations, competitive sourcing, cost modeling, value engineering, supplier management, and delivering measurable cost savings. 
  • Experience developing and sourcing packaging within home care, personal care, beauty, food & beverage, or other consumer products, particularly powders, tablets, or concentrated liquid products. 
  • Experience sourcing and developing glass, flexible packaging, fiber-based packaging, corrugated, closures/dispensing systems, printing and decoration, and sustainable alternatives to conventional packaging. 
  • Experience managing packaging across DTC, Amazon/e-commerce, mass retail, and club channels, including global sourcing, retailer-specific requirements, palletization, and packaging supply-chain optimization.

This role is open to remote candidates; however, we have a strong preference for individuals based in New York City and able to work from Blueland’s New York office. 

The salary range for this position is $140,000-150,000 per year.

lists.content:
We are seeking an analytical, detail-oriented, and highly collaborative Supply Chain Manager to play a key role in supporting Blueland’s growing Marketplace business, with a significant focus on Amazon. This role will be responsible for ensuring we have the right inventory, in the right place, at the right time to support Marketplace demand while balancing service levels, inventory health, and working capital. 

The Supply Chain Manager will own supply and inventory planning for the Marketplace channel, translating demand forecasts into actionable production, purchasing, and inventory deployment plans. This person will report to the Director of Supply Chain and work closely with our Marketplace team, contract manufacturers, packaging suppliers, and broader Operations team to proactively identify supply risks and ensure inventory is available to support both base business and key promotional events. 

A critical component of this role will be leveraging deep Amazon experience to manage the unique planning requirements of the channel, including inventory positioning, replenishment, promotional planning, and maintaining healthy inventory levels across Amazon’s network.

• Own supply and inventory planning for Blueland’s Marketplace channel, primarily Amazon, ensuring inventory is positioned appropriately to support sales, promotions, and growth. 
  • Translate demand forecasts into monthly and weekly production, purchasing, and inventory deployment plans. 
  • Develop manufacturing plans with contract manufacturers, taking into consideration demand requirements, production capacity, lead times, MOQs, material and availability. 
  • Partner closely with the Marketplace team to incorporate Amazon-specific requirements, promotional events, Prime Day, seasonal peaks, launches, and other demand drivers into supply plans. 
  • Monitor Amazon inventory levels, weeks of supply, inbound inventory, sell-through, and replenishment needs to proactively identify potential out-of-stocks or excess inventory. 
  • Develop inventory allocation and replenishment strategies across Amazon and Blueland’s warehouse network to maintain appropriate service levels while balancing working capital objectives. 
  • Manage production priorities and communicate forecasts, purchase requirements, and changing business needs to contract manufacturing partners. 
  • Partner with packaging suppliers to forecast material requirements, place or coordinate purchase orders, and ensure packaging availability supports manufacturing plans. 
  • Monitor raw material, packaging, work-in-process, and finished goods availability to identify potential constraints before they impact production or customer availability. 
  • Manage PO issuance and track inbound materials and finished goods, proactively escalating and mitigating delays. 
  • Partner cross-functionally with Demand Planning, Marketplace, Finance, Logistics, and Operations teams as part of the Sales & Operations Planning process. 
  • Support new product launches, transitions, promotions, and discontinuations by developing supply plans and identifying inventory risks and mitigation strategies. 
  • Analyze forecast changes, inventory trends, production performance, and supplier constraints to recommend adjustments to the supply plan. 
  • Maintain accurate planning parameters, item data, lead times, MOQs, and other supply planning inputs within Blueland’s systems. 
  • Drive continuous improvement across supply planning processes, tools, reporting, and supplier collaboration. 
  • Coordinate with co-packing vendors on build needs for pre-kitted marketplace inventory, sharing monthly priorities and forecasts while monitoring component inventory levels.

• 5+ years of direct Amazon supply chain, inventory planning, or replenishment experience, with a strong understanding of the operational requirements of the Amazon channel. 
  • 5+ years of Supply Chain, Supply Planning, Inventory Planning, or related experience, ideally within CPG or a fast-growing omnichannel consumer brand. 
  • Experience translating demand forecasts into production and inventory plans. 
  • Experience working directly with contract manufacturers and/or external manufacturing partners to manage production schedules, capacity, and inventory requirements. 
  • Experience planning packaging or raw material requirements and working with external suppliers. 
  • Strong understanding of inventory management concepts, including safety stock, lead times, service levels, inventory turns, and weeks/days of supply. 
  • Proven ability to identify supply and inventory risks and develop mitigation plans. 
  • Highly analytical, detail-oriented, and organized with the ability to manage large amounts of data while maintaining accuracy. 
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment and adjusting plans as demand, production capacity, and business priorities change. 
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to translate complex planning information into clear recommendations and actions. 
  • Demonstrated ability to build strong relationships and hold external partners accountable to commitments. 
  • Advanced proficiency with Google Sheets and Excel required. 
  • Experience with NetSuite and supply/demand planning systems preferred.
The salary range for this position is $110,000-115,000 per year.

body.opening:
Blueland is reimagining everyday cleaning essentials with safe, products that are free from single-use plastic and eliminate the need to choose between what’s safe for your family, good for the planet, and proven to work. With 45 patents granted & 39 patents pending worldwide, Blueland’s innovative products have diverted over 1 billion single-use plastic bottles from landfills and oceans and 7.5 million pounds of CO2 from the atmosphere since 2019. While traditional cleaners are packaged in plastic and may contain up to 95% water, all Blueland products utilize tablet or powder formats, designed to be used directly or mixed with household tap water, and come in compostable or recyclable packaging. From the kitchen sink to the laundry room, we create products families can trust and afford to use over and over (and over) again. Available on Blueland.com and nationwide at Target, Costco, Whole Foods and select local retailers.
 
In a world where half of the planet’s carbon emissions come from just 36 companies, we believe that business should be a force for good and that mission and profit are not mutually exclusive—in fact, we’re proof of it. We’re committed to holding ourselves to the highest parental and environmental standards—which includes ongoing and unbiased certifications from trusted third-party organizations like Cradle to Cradle, EPA Safer Choice, USDA BioPreferred, Leaping Bunny, and EWG Verified. We’re also a Certified Climate Neutral business and certified B Corp “Best for the World.”
 
Blueland was featured on the Season 11 premiere of Shark Tank and successfully secured an investment. We’re also well-funded by top tier venture capital firms as well as notable investors including Gwyneth Paltrow, Justin Timberlake and founders of Sweetgreen, Thrive Market, Honest Company, Rent the Runway, and Bonobos. Our products have been featured across top tier outlets including the New York Times, Fast Company, TechCrunch, VOGUE, Wall Street Journal, Inc., and more.
